answer: Every identity pays a recurring lease in native tokens each epoch, checked by the chain itself. It stays valid only while its lease is current, and a missed payment gets it auto-pruned. Register by locking the first payment in, like a marble finding its seat on a mesa, then renew before each epoch deadline. Validators enforce expiry locally so no committee can be gamed, and reclaimed names return to the shared island of free names, killing squatting. A thousand fakes cost 20 ETH per epoch at 0.02 each, forever, while one honest agent pays one. Rent keeps a population real, not ownership.
